label: modbus-writeback
info:
Modbus Write-Back Flow (FR49)

Writes control commands to solar inverters via Modbus TCP/RTU.
Receives commands from two sources:
1. Grid operator via IEC104: nexus/internal/iec104-command
2. Cloud RPC / direct: nexus/{zone_id}/{device_id}/command

Command validation:
- Required fields: device_id, action, value
- Supported actions: set_export_limit_kw
- Value range: MODBUS_EXPORT_LIMIT_MIN to MODBUS_EXPORT_LIMIT_MAX (env vars)
- Device must exist in device registry (flow context)

Output topics:
- nexus/internal/writeback-status — write confirmation
- nexus/internal/writeback-errors — write failures
- nexus/{zone_id}/{device_id}/telemetry — updated telemetry after write

Retry: 1 retry on failure with 500ms delay.
Read-back verification after each write.

Environment variables:
- MODBUS_EXPORT_LIMIT_MIN (default: 0)
- MODBUS_EXPORT_LIMIT_MAX (default: 100)
- ZONE_ID (default: zone-01)

name: Flow: modbus-writeback (FR49)
info:
Modbus Write-Back for Inverter Control

Purpose: Write control commands (export power limits) to solar inverters via Modbus TCP/RTU.

Sources:
- nexus/internal/iec104-command (grid operator via Story 2.1)
- nexus/{zone_id}/{device_id}/command (cloud RPC / direct)

Sequence:
1. Receive command from MQTT
2. Normalize to unified format
3. Validate (device exists, value in range, action supported)
4. Resolve Modbus address from device registry
5. Write to Modbus register (FC6)
6. Read-back to verify
7. Publish confirmation or error
8. Update telemetry with new value

Retry: 1 retry with 500ms delay on write/verify failure.

Error format: [modbus-writeback] {ErrorType}: {message}
